subject: Close playbook: Oct 28 cutover — ops hotwash & fallback roster
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Claire Tang <claire.tang@cardiosense.com>; Raj Patel <raj.patel@cardiosense.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Close playbook: Oct 28 cutover — weekly checkpoint

Claire / Raj —

Quick MAP checkpoint following our Friday run-through. Attached is the latest mutual action plan (CardioSense-MAP-v5.xlsx) and an early cutover-runbook draft. High-level: we remain on track for the Oct 28 production cutover but we want to tighten the runbook and finalize rollback doors by next week.

Top outstanding items for this checkpoint:
- Finalize runbook ownership for each checklist item (who will execute + who will observe).
- Confirm dry-run window (we propose Oct 20, 09:00 PT).
- Lock network change freeze and DB migration window (you called for 2 hours, we need exact start/end).
- Identify fallback model variant and routing policy in case of degraded latency.

Ask for CardioSense: please confirm owners for DB migration and post-cutover validation (2 names) by EOD Monday.

Internal note: Laura to collate runbook owners; Ben owns rollback validation; I will lead post-cutover smoke tests.

Attachments: CardioSense-MAP-v5.xlsx (MAP with milestones), cutover-runbook-draft.md (early runbook), rollback-checklist-v1.pdf (initial rollback gating).

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

From: Claire Tang <claire.tang@cardiosense.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@cardiosense.com>, Ops Team <ops@cardiosense.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close playbook: Oct 28 cutover — weekly checkpoint

Thanks Jonas — this is clear and appreciated.

Quick answers:
- DB migration owners: Raj Patel (lead) and Priya Kumar (validation). I copied Raj here.
- Dry-run: Oct 20 09:00 PT works for our core ops team; we may need a +30m buffer at the end for rollback rehearsals.
- Network freeze: We can commit to 2 hours starting at 02:00 PT on Oct 28 (we are in a planned off-peak).

Question: can Redwood provide a short pre-cutover checklist for the emergency rollback (items we should validate before triggering rollback)? If you already have that in the rollback-checklist-v1.pdf we can review but a 1-page quick-reference would be ideal for our on-call.

We will confirm the two DB owners formally on Monday.

Claire
Director, Cloud Ops
CardioSense
claire.tang@cardiosense.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close playbook: Oct 28 cutover — weekly checkpoint

Team — consolidating owners against the runbook (see inline). I pulled the draft into the shared Drive folder and added a compact owners heatmap. Inline summary: 

- Pre-cutover validation (0-2h before): Grace O'Connor (lead), Karthik Iyer (observer)
- DB migration (cutover window): Raj Patel (CardioSense lead), Ben Carter (Redwood DB rollback owner)
- Feature flag flip & canary: Jonas Weber (owner) with Ben observing
- Post-cutover smoke and perf checks (0-60m after): Jonas (lead), Laura (validation + stakeholder comms)
- Rollback decision authority: Ben Carter (executes rollback), Claire/Raj (CardioSense final say to request rollback)

Action items (owners & target dates):
1) Ben to document the automated rollback command and test it in staging — due Oct 13.
2) Grace to finalize the one-page emergency rollback quick-reference for on-call — due Oct 8.
3) Jonas to schedule Oct 20 dry-run and invite CardioSense ops + Redwood runbook leads — invite out by today.
4) Karthik to validate routing policy for fallback model variant and produce a short config diff — due Oct 12.

Notes: I added a short 'go/no-go' decision matrix into the runbook (in Drive). Please review before the dry-run so we can iterate.

Laura Bennett
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Claire Tang <claire.tang@cardiosense.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@cardiosense.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close playbook: Oct 28 cutover — ops hotwash & fallback roster — notes + meeting

Thanks all —

Meeting scheduled: Dry-run + hotwash — Oct 20, 09:00-11:00 PT. Calendar invites sent to ops leads and runbook owners. Agenda: 1) staged dry-run of migration sequence; 2) rollback drill; 3) canary verification & perf acceptance; 4) post-drill hotwash + open actions.

Quick meeting notes from owner's consolidation:
- Owners and action due dates as Laura listed above.
- Ben: add automated rollback command snippet to Drive by Oct 13 and mark the exact S3 snapshot id naming convention.
- Grace: will produce single-page quick-ref and post to Drive; ops on-call will be looped.
- Karthik: routing policy diff will include threshold values for 95th percentile latency fallback (default: 350ms) — he will also prepare a measuring hook for the runbook.

Next steps for CardioSense: please confirm Raj/Priya as DB owners in HubSpot (I added deal activity) and share any additional blackout windows.

References: HubSpot deal (CS-2026-042): https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/CS-2026-042
